additional_info.subject: Report of left connector fault – Charging station 160 MP/R6 (S/N 170002081)
additional_info.body:
Hello,
The left connector of the 160 MP/R6 charging station (S/N 170002081) is currently faulty.
Despite several reboot attempts, the issue persists and the connector remains unavailable.
To explain the constraints: the client operates 4 trucks and is forced, every hour, to return to the site to move the charged truck and reconnect the truck that has not been charged to the faulty connector.
He has been doing this all week and cannot continue if the situation persists next week.
Please note that another ticket had already been opened previously on this same charger regarding a screen malfunction.
Could you please analyze the root cause of the fault and propose a rapid corrective action.
Thank you in advance.
Kind regards,
Malek DRIF | Head of Operations | Mob:
+33 650 370 485
SAS AUTORECHARGE |
WWW.AUTORECHARGE.FR
|

additional_info.subject: ID0479764-DC/Si-D/FR-[MP/R6 170002081]Report of left connector fault CRM:02889001148
additional_info.body:
Dear Malek,
Thank you for your email back.
After checking the charging session you have mentioned, we see that this charging session didn`t stop at 47% but at 87%, and only stopped because the car was not requesting any more kw from the charger.
We will show this in the following logs:
In this log you are able to see that the charger was charging until 47% at the time you have mentioned (with 1 hour difference because of the timezone)
In the following log you are able to see that after some errors, the charger was able to recover the charging session, and the charger continued charging.
At 06:00 in France time, the charging session stopped at 87%, because the car was not requesting any more power from the charger.
After this the charging stopped.
During the charging session, we have only come across some communication errors, which didn`t effect the charging session to charge until the car was not requesting any more power.
We hope that this has clarified your request.
Thank you.
Kind regards,
Priscilla van Wettum

Dear Malek,
Thank you for your email back.
After checking the charging session you have mentioned, we see that this charging session didn`t stop at 47% but at 87%, and only stopped because the car was not requesting any more kw from the charger.
We will show this in the following logs:
In this log you are able to see that the charger was charging until 47% at the time you have mentioned (with 1 hour difference because of the timezone)
In the following log you are able to see that after some errors, the charger was able to recover the charging session, and the charger continued charging.
At 06:00 in France time, the charging session stopped at 87%, because the car was not requesting any more power from the charger.
After this the charging stopped.
During the charging session, we have only come across some communication errors, which didn`t effect the charging session to charge until the car was not requesting any more power.
We hope that this has clarified your request.
Thank you.
Kind regards,
Priscilla van Wettum
